meta.name: 1 Out Of 7
meta.description: Runaway teen Lexi find herself alone and pregnant on the streets. Seemingly beyond hope, she must turn to Devon, a woman with her own demons, to help her find a way back from her past mistakes.
meta.slogan: Two million American youth run away from home each year. One in seven will live on the streets before the age of 18. This is one of their stories.
